description: CROWDSEC_BAN : pays (crowdsec_country), adresse bannie (origin.ip) et géolocalisation (origin.geolocation, celle d'UTMStack si présente, sinon geoip)

script.source: if (ctx.raw != null && ctx.raw.contains('CROWDSEC_BAN')) { def m = /country[=:\"]{1,3}([A-Z]{2})/.matcher(ctx.raw); if (m.find()) { ctx.crowdsec_country = m.group(1); } def i = /"ip":"([0-9a-fA-F.:]+)"/.matcher(ctx.raw); if (i.find()) { if (ctx.origin == null) { ctx.origin = new HashMap(); } ctx.origin.ip = i.group(1); } def ll = /"lat":"(-?[0-9.]+)","lon":"(-?[0-9.]+)"/.matcher(ctx.raw); if (ll.find() && ctx.origin != null) { def g = new HashMap(); g.latitude = Double.parseDouble(ll.group(1)); g.longitude = Double.parseDouble(ll.group(2)); if (ctx.crowdsec_country != null) { g.countryCode = ctx.crowdsec_country; } ctx.origin.geolocation = g; } }

if (ctx._tmpgeo != null) { if (ctx.origin.geolocation == null) { ctx.origin.geolocation = new HashMap(); } def g = ctx.origin.geolocation; if (ctx._tmpgeo.location != null) { g.latitude = ctx._tmpgeo.location.lat; g.longitude = ctx._tmpgeo.location.lon; } if (ctx._tmpgeo.country_name != null) { g.country = ctx._tmpgeo.country_name; } if (ctx._tmpgeo.country_iso_code != null) { g.countryCode = ctx._tmpgeo.country_iso_code; } if (ctx._tmpgeo.city_name != null) { g.city = ctx._tmpgeo.city_name; } ctx.remove('_tmpgeo'); }
